operations.name: Saw Cut Tube Blanks
operations.setup_note: Clamp certified precision cold-drawn seamless tubing in a tube-supporting vice and set the length stop for individual blanks with facing allowance at both ends. Verify material certification, including the specified minimum yield strength, before releasing the lot.

operations.name: CNC Turn – First End
operations.setup_note: Grip the opposite raw end in bored soft jaws, exposing the first-end profile and complete central barrel; establish the process axis from the tube OD and the axial reference by facing. Bore sub-operations 3–4 address only the first accessible portion of the enlarged cavity using qualified retractable tooling, while sub-operation 5 sizes the first end entry; cavity machining remains conditional on clarification of F01.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Second End
operations.setup_note: Reverse the part into protective bored soft jaws on the finished central OD, locate axially from the first finished face, and face the opposite end to overall length. Bore sub-operations 3–4 complete the remaining enlarged cavity from this end without recutting the end-entry diameter, while sub-operation 5 sizes the second entry; qualify the cavity connection and shoulder locations before production.

operations.name: Production Deburr and Clean
operations.setup_note: Support the completed unhardened sleeve in a padded bench cradle and rapidly remove machining burrs from both ends and the accessible internal shoulders. Break remaining sharp edges within the drawing's 0.5 mm maximum without altering the specified profiles, then flush and blow out the passage.

operations.name: Corrosion-Resistant Treatment – Provisional Zinc
operations.setup_note: Load fully machined and deburred sleeves into the in-house bulk barrel line only after approval of the applicable coating specification and coverage. Process the 100-piece order as one batch if within the qualified barrel load, otherwise split into qualified loads; alkaline zinc is provisional and dimensions must account for the approved deposit.

operations.name: Final Shop-Floor Quality Gate
operations.setup_note: Present finished parts to dedicated snap, plug, length and profile gauges using the sleeve axis and finished end faces as process references, with first-off and SPC sampling rather than 100% dimensional layout. Verify the central OD finish and approved coating requirements through first-article qualification and appropriate sampled checks.

operations.name: Sampled Crush Test
operations.setup_note: Send representative sacrificial finished samples to a qualified vendor for the controlled PS-122.5 crush procedure using the specified loading orientation and calibrated equipment. Provisionally sample one part per 100-piece lot; additional production is required if all 100 pieces must remain deliverable.

clarifications.question: Please provide the fully dimensioned F01 internal-cavity profile between the two minimum-14-mm end entries.
clarifications.suggested_default: Retain a conditional two-ended retractable-boring route, but do not assign a cavity nominal diameter or axial extent from the 28.94 mm maximum alone.

clarifications.question: Are the internal transitions from the end-entry bores to the enlarged cavity square perpendicular shoulders?
clarifications.suggested_default: Provisionally retain the extraction assumption of square shoulders, subject to tooling feasibility and customer approval.

clarifications.question: What numerical general-tolerance specification governs the untoleranced dimensions?
clarifications.suggested_default: Do not treat ASME Y14.5M-1994 as a numerical tolerance table; use ISO 2768-m only if expressly approved.

clarifications.question: What corrosion-resistant coating specification applies to IC01B081220 marked AS SHOWN?
clarifications.suggested_default: Provisionally route in-house alkaline zinc without assigning a deposit thickness; hold coating release until the applicable specification is confirmed.

clarifications.question: Which surfaces must remain uncoated?
clarifications.suggested_default: Provisionally assume no selectively uncoated surfaces and compensate coated dimensions; add masking and unmasking if exclusions are specified.

clarifications.question: Do the drawing's dimensional limits apply after coating?
clarifications.suggested_default: Assume final delivered dimensions apply after coating and adjust machining targets for the approved deposit.

clarifications.question: Please supply the controlled PS-122.5 crush-test procedure.
clarifications.suggested_default: Plan one sacrificial sample per 100-piece lot, but do not infer fixture orientation or acceptance criteria solely from the extracted load and displacement values.

clarifications.question: Is certified precision cold-drawn seamless tubing acceptable for the specified cold-drawn steel material callout?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use certified near-net seamless tubing meeting the specified chemistry and minimum 472 MPa yield strength, subject to material-form approval and procurement confirmation.

assumptions.text: World Z is the sleeve axis. Finished end faces and the sleeve axis are manufacturing references only; no drawing datum letters or datum-based GD&T are invented.

The tubular-stock correction overrides solid-bar selection. The proposed 46.5 mm OD by 19.5 mm ID precision cold-drawn seamless tube is a procurement candidate, not a confirmed commercial size; certification must demonstrate the specified material requirements and minimum yield strength.

The 114.4 mm blank length uses the maximum part envelope plus 6 mm facing allowance. Near-net tube cleanup replaces hot-rolled bar allowances; one central-OD finish skim is retained to physically achieve F07 diameter and Ra 1.2, with no full-body rough/finish sequence.

F01 represents both end entries and the intervening enlarged passage. Separate bore sub-operations distinguish entry sizing from cavity enlargement so different diameters are not combined in one cut; each cavity sub-operation remains provisional until the internal profile is supplied.

The enlarged cavity is provisionally machined from both ends using retractable or equivalent qualified internal tooling. The 28.94 mm maximum is not adopted as a nominal diameter, and minimum entry length is not treated as total passage depth.

Each end uses one consolidated lathe setup with facing, canned profile roughing and finishing, boring and chamfering. F03 and F05 are produced incidentally in the end-profile finish pass under the organizational override; no separate fillet form-turning or groove operation is added.

The turning template's center drilling is omitted because the part is hollow and its overall L/D is below 4. Part-off is omitted because individual blanks are saw cut and both ends are subsequently faced; discrete grooves, threads and knurling are omitted because none are specified.

The hole-making template's spotting, pilot drilling, full drilling and peck drilling are omitted because the starting tube already has a passage. Reaming, tapping and fastener countersinks/counterbores are omitted because no corresponding fit, thread or fastener recess is specified; boring and hole deburring remain.

No hardening, grinding or honing is routed. The part is unhardened, the bore tolerance does not require H7 finishing, and F07 tolerance and Ra 1.2 do not meet the organizational exception for OD grinding.

All dimensional machining and edge breaking precede corrosion treatment. Alkaline zinc is a provisional routing default only; the related-part PS-152 callouts are not automatically assigned to the AS SHOWN part.

Surface-treatment masking and unmasking are provisionally omitted because no threads, H7 bores or explicitly uncoated mating surfaces are identified. These steps must be added if coating coverage clarification requires them; final dimensions are provisionally interpreted as post-coating.

A separate cure or hydrogen-relief bake is not assumed for provisional zinc treatment of unhardened low-carbon steel. Revisit this omission if the approved coating specification or certified material strength requires baking; coating-line cleaning, activation and rinsing belong to the qualified plating process.

Production-line deburr, cleaning, gauge-inspection and sampled-test corrections apply to Pass 2 cycle estimates, not the one-time setup times reported here. Near-net OD and entry-bore work use the organizational turning benchmarks, but undefined enlarged-cavity machining cannot be assumed to fit those benchmarks without qualification.

Crush testing is sampled rather than performed on every piece. It is subcontracted because a qualified 220 kN mechanical crush capability is not established by the supplied in-house equipment profile; destructive samples require overbuild if 100 acceptable deliverable pieces are required.
